verdict.rationale: AWS documents that some of its own first-party components are open source: the AWS CDK is described as an open-source framework, and AWS publishes open-source MCP servers on GitHub. Nothing in the evidence shows the source of the core cloud platform or its services is readable, and no specific license is named. missing for 10: source availability for the core AWS platform/services, named open-license terms (e.g., Apache-2.0), independent corroboration of license and repository access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) is an open-source software development framework for defining cloud infrastructure in code
